derived: 2026-09-02, empirically: flat-colour flood per strip + black notches at x=64/128/192 (widths 2/4/6), read back from a ds3-shot in-game capture at 1920x1080

bar_backdrop.notes: frame/backdrop behind all three bars; drawn 16 px tall on screen (1:1 vertical), full bar length; fill band covers its middle 12 rows

hp_fill.notes: one 24-row graphic, minified 2:1 vertically to the 12 px HP fill band (screen y77-88 for shotbot); also sampled at low alpha by the weapon-slot durability gauges (screen y~907-912)

stamina_fill.notes: same anatomy; stamina band was screen y111-122

fp_fill.notes: same anatomy; FP band was screen y94-105

unknown_olive.notes: never appeared in a full-bars capture; vanilla olive colouring suggests the damage-lag/depleted variant

endcaps_and_icons.notes: bar end-cap arrowheads, ember faces, status icons; left untouched

screen_mapping.horizontal: 1:1, texture x + 192 = screen x for the left-anchored bars (notches at tex x 64/128/192 landed at screen x 256/320/384 in ALL bars regardless of bar length); bars shorter than 256 px crop the strip, longer presumably clamp the edge texel (unverified, needs a high-level character)
screen_mapping.vertical: backdrop 16 rows -> 16 px (1:1); each 24-row fill block -> 12 px (2:1 minified)

probe_constraint: ds3-shot's hud probe samples screen y78-88 (wants red-dominant) and y113-121 (green-dominant); any replacement art for hp_fill/stamina_fill must keep those bands passing or the inventory journey dies at wait_probe
